text:
Ken (SE): quick sync — NewCorp POC timeline. Target dry-run on staging Wed 4/7, customer UAT 4/14. Need confirmation on networking + model endpoint owners and any infra blockers.
Maya R: I can own staging networking (VPC peering, firewall rules). Will need a list of IPs from NewCorp.
Sam W: I can take model endpoint deploys and monitoring. Planning a canary rollout first.
Ken (SE): @Maya R awesome. @Sam W can you confirm image tag we should deploy? we should pin so we can rollback.
Sam W: Use tag newcorp-v1.2. I’ll add a rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m with health checks.
Jordan L: Heads-up: infra will throttle large batch inference on the shared pool. For the POC we should request a small dedicated slot or set max_batch=8.
Priya S: For acceptance criteria: 95th pct latency < 300ms for single-turn requests, and 99% success rate for 1k concurrent sessions. Is that what Sales promised?
Ken (SE): yes, those were the numbers from the SOW. I’ll add them to the checklist.
Maya R: NewCorp asked for TLS mutual auth on the endpoint. We need cert exchange. @Sam W does our private plane support mTLS right now?
Sam W: We have mTLS support but need to wire in their CA to the load balancer. @Jordan L can you open a ticket to provision an LB cert and a CA bundle config?
Jordan L: Opening ENG-5921 now with details. ETA for LB config is EOD Tuesday if no blockers.
Priya S: Also adding a data residency ask — logs must not leave eu-west-1 for the POC. Can infra scope logging to region?
Maya R: Yes, we can set log sinks to eu-west-1. Will coordinate with priv infra.
Ken (SE): Quick validation curl for their team to smoke test after deploy:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-newcorp.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":16}'
```
Ken (SE): Can someone add that to the runbook?
Sam W: I’ll add it and include expected response shape + example assertions.
Jordan L: On quotas — we should set a rate limit for the trial to 100 req/s to avoid noisy neighbors. I’ll add a per-client quota in ENG-5921.
Priya S: For go/no-go on Wed dry-run: 1) LB + mTLS configured, 2) model deployed and passes smoke, 3) regional logging confirmed, 4) quotas applied. Anything else?
Maya R: DB credentials — NewCorp needs a read-only API key to fetch metadata. Need SE to confirm schema.
Ken (SE): @Maya R I’ll send schema by EOD.
Sam W: I have a small PR for the health-check endpoint — pinging @Jordan L for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/compare/PR-234
Jordan L: Reviewing now, expect comments in the next hour.
Oncall Bot: deploy-staging: succeeded — service/newcorp-endpoint @ staging (sha: a1b2c3) — https://deploys.redwood.ai/tx/98765
Ken (SE): Thanks all. Action items: Maya -> networking + logs; Sam -> deploy + runbook; Jordan -> LB + quota ticket ENG-5921; Priya -> confirm acceptance tests and data residency checklist. Re-check here after EOD Tues. :thumbsup:
